claims.text: The Wedgewood Hotel & Spa is in the heart of Downtown Vancouver.

findings.quote: Located in the heart of Downtown Vancouver, the Wedgewood Hotel & Spa is a family-owned and operated boutique hotel

claims.text: The hotel's address is across from Robson Square and the Vancouver Art Gallery.

findings.quote: With its distinguished address across from picturesque Robson Square and Vancouver Art Gallery

claims.text: The Wedgewood is a family-owned and operated boutique hotel.

findings.quote: the Wedgewood Hotel & Spa is a family-owned and operated boutique hotel

claims.text: In 1984 founder Eleni Skalbania bought the former Mayfair Apartment Hotel and redesigned it, acting as her own designer.

findings.quote: She found the perfect location in 1984 when she purchased the former Mayfair Apartment Hotel
She fully renovated and redesigned the property, acting as her own designer and project manager.
Our founder Eleni Skalbania

claims.text: The hotel says it opened in 1984 as the first female-owned boutique property in Canada.

findings.quote: was an immediate success when it opened in the summer of 1984
To signify the opening of the first female-owned boutique property in Canada

claims.text: The Wedgewood is a second-generation, female owned-and-operated property.

findings.quote: As a second generation female owned-and-operated property

claims.text: Conde Nast Traveler says even the smallest rooms have separate sitting areas and work desks.

findings.quote: Even the smallest rooms have separate sitting areas and work desks.

claims.text: Bacchus Restaurant & Lounge, inside the hotel, has Venetian decor and original artwork.

findings.quote: Tucked away inside the Wedgewood, Michelin-Recommended Bacchus Restaurant & Lounge beckons with beautiful Venetian decor, original artwork and impeccable service.

claims.text: Afternoon tea is available daily, with teas from Vancouver purveyor Murchie's.

findings.quote: It’s available daily and puts a local spin on things by using a Vancouver purveyor, Murchie’s, to stock all their teas.

claims.text: The hotel can arrange bike rentals and private yoga classes on request.

findings.quote: The hotel can also arrange bike rentals and private yoga classes upon request.

claims.text: Conde Nast Traveler suggests renting a bike and heading for the Seawall to Stanley Park.

findings.quote: grabbing a bike rental and heading for the Seawall to Stanley Park

claims.text: The Wedgewood is a Relais & Chateaux member.

findings.quote: a distinguished Relais & Chateaux member

claims.text: To create the ambience of a European country house, the founder displayed art and antiques she had collected and commissioned custom-built furniture.

findings.quote: To create the ambience of a European country-house she displayed a collection of art and antiques she had personally collected, and commissioned craftsmen to build custom-designed furniture.

claims.text: The Spa at the Wedgewood has a relaxation lounge, a eucalyptus steam room, private treatment rooms and couples massage suites.

findings.quote: Featuring a tranquil relaxation lounge, a eucalyptus steam room, well appointed private treatment rooms, and spacious couples massage suites

claims.text: Conde Nast Traveler says larger rooms can come with terraces, fireplaces and standalone bathtubs.

findings.quote: Larger rooms can come with terraces, fireplaces and standalone bath tubs.

claims.text: The 4th Baron of Wedgwood attended the hotel's opening.

findings.quote: the 4th Baron of Wedgwood attended the opening

claims.text: Bacchus Lounge has classic cocktails and live piano performances nightly.

findings.quote: A sophisticated destination for casual favourites, classic cocktails and live piano performances nightly

claims.text: Executive Rooms have a limited laneway view.

findings.quote: Limited Laneway View

claims.text: Conde Nast Traveler describes the gym as small but serviceable, with TechnoGym equipment.

findings.quote: There’s a small, but serviceable gym with TechnoGym equipment.

findings.quote: Not particularly; one child under 12 is included in the room rate
